description:
Advances: ancora.derive

Stage: L8 (05a-stages-library.md). Plan run dir on epic ancora-yzu.

Deliverable:
Ancora.Derive.Extract (all clauses for {M,f,a} after default expansion across def/defmacro/defguard/defdelegate; sibling attributes excluded; one source-ordered list), Ancora.Canonical (metadata strip only; no alpha-renaming; charlist/sigil non-normalization documented; mix format --migrate named as an expect-acknowledgment case), Ancora.Derive.Compare (drift only where the defining file is in the change set; dedupe per definition; growth/shrink from set difference; AR6 generated-binding rules incl. companion __using__/1 bindings and the transition-is-drift rule), Ancora.Derive.Ack (substantive requirement/scenario change against parsed spec AST, whitespace collapsed in string values), Ancora.SubjectFiles (footprint = tagged test files union derived-binding defining files), and the Ancora.Derive pipeline orchestration (Task.async_stream over tagged test files, ordered: false, max_concurrency schedulers_online, workers share only the ETS memo).

Verification:
- Tests to pass: tagged_tests covering ancora.derive.clause_extraction, canonical_is_metadata_strip, drift_scope_and_dedupe, growth_and_shrink, generated_bindings, acknowledgment_is_substantive, subject_footprint, formatter_round_trip (canonical half)
- Behaviors to demonstrate: ancora.derive.scenario.canonical_table, defdelegate_retarget_fires, doc_only_edit_is_quiet, default_arity_reports_once, unchanged_file_not_parsed, macro_injected_api_drifts_via_companion, repo_insert_stays_silent, def_moved_into_use_is_drift, whitespace_never_acknowledges (stream_data; the two branches must be able to disagree), meta_edit_does_not_acknowledge, footprint_union, new_dir_new_test_is_growth (growth half), deleted_module_visible_at_base (shrink half), own_corpus_round_trip (canonical half)
- Verification cadence:
  - Iteration tier: mix test --stale or named files plus mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora from specled_ex; no full suite mid-iteration
  - Final tier: the four common merge-gate commands run-until-green before IMPLEMENTED
  - Verifier tier: tagged tests for the ids above plus --stale only
- Standing bounce-class checks:
  - Production call site named for each new callable surface: Compare/Ack/SubjectFiles consumed by Gate (L9); proving tests here are the unit matrices
  - Fixture hygiene: all-pure modules; fixtures are source strings; tests async
  - Spec surfaces kept fresh for every touched callable surface
  - Every conditional clause covered (each canonical row, each AR6 rule, each Ack branch)
- Call-site Integration: Ancora.Gate (L9) calls Derive.run/2 then Compare and Ack per subject; proving tests here are the unit matrices, and L9 adds diff-scoping integration cases.

Out of Scope (files):
- lib/ancora/gate*, lib/ancora/output*, lib/mix/tasks/**
- lib/ancora/derive/{change_set,module_locator,membership,def_index,resolver}.ex (read-only here)
Allowed touches (this stage may modify):
- lib/ancora/derive/extract.ex, lib/ancora/derive/compare.ex, lib/ancora/derive/ack.ex, lib/ancora/canonical.ex, lib/ancora/subject_files.ex, lib/ancora/derive.ex (pipeline)
- test/ancora/derive/{extract,compare,ack,pipeline}_test.exs, test/ancora/{canonical,subject_files}_test.exs, test/fixtures/**, test/support/**
- NOTICE (Canonical origin)
- .spec/specs/ancora.derive.spec.md (acknowledging edits to requirement/scenario blocks only; never weakening)

Out of Scope (intent):
- no alpha-renaming; no sigil/charlist folding; no hashing anywhere in the detector path
- no finding for dep-generated bindings
- no parsing of files outside the change set for drift

Merge gate:
- [ ] mix compile --warnings-as-errors
- [ ] mix test
- [ ] mix format --check-formatted
- [ ] mix deps.unlock --check-unused
- [ ] mix spec.validate --root /Users/mz/src/ancora passes (from specled_ex checkout)
- [ ] Scope check: diff touches only Allowed globs (mechanical)
- [ ] Auditor APPROVE comment on the ticket
title: L8: Detector II — extraction, canonical, compare, acknowledgment
